summary: 144, Anna Salai, Chennai-600 002 . Petitioner - _(a) Direct NLDC to bring on record before this Hon'ble Commission, block-wise drawal details of the applicant using an inter-state transmission system and ISTS and IntraSTS from ISGS for the period from 2018-2019 to 2023-2024._ - _(c) Pass any other order or further relief(s) as may be deemed fit in the present facts and circumstances of the case._ - _c) Direct SRPC to notify the revised RTA/RTDA based on revised LTA notified by respondent no.1._ - _e) Direct the respondents to compensate the indirect loss incurred by the petitioner on account of purchase of power from other sources to meet the “quantum of power” reduced by respondents on account of ISTS losses due to non-compliance of Regulation 13(11) of Sharing Regulation 2020._ - _f) Direct the defaulting respondents (1) & (2) to bear the petition filing fee._ - _g) Pass any other order or orders as this Hon’ble Commission may deem fit and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case._ The pleadings made in the IA has been considered in the instant Order. However, the Prayers made in the main Petition have been included only for reference. i) During the 39[th] TCC/SRPC meetings held on 3[rd] and 6[th ] December 2021, the matter was deliberated. Despite the repeated request from TNPDCL (Erstwhile TANGEDCO) to consider all four cases in line with the Commissioner’s various orders and in line with the provisions of THE Sharing Regulations, CTUIL and SRPC were not inclined to consider the views of TNPDCL (Erstwhile TANGEDCO). Upon the vehement insistence of TNPDCL (Erstwhile TANGEDCO), the committee agreed to recommend only the MAPS and NLC TPS-II stage-I cases. _2. Learned counsel for the Central Transmission Utility of India Limited (CTUIL), sought permission to upload/file an affidavit on the e-filing Portal in compliance with the Record of Proceedings (RoP) dated 19.2.2025, wherein the Commission had directed CTUIL to submit the details of the quantum of LTA/MTOA in respect of all regional entity generating stations connected with both the ISTS and intra-State transmission systems located in the State of the Petitioner and covered under the instant Petition for the period from 1.11.2020 till 30.9.2023. He further submitted that the said affidavit has been served upon all the concerned parties, including the Petitioner._ _3. After the hearing, the Commission acceded to the request of CTUIL and directed the Registry to open the portal to enable CTUIL to file its compliance affidavit.”_ _“At the outset, the learned counsel for the Petitioner, referring to the Record of Proceedings (RoP) dated 19.2.2025, submitted that the Petitioner has filed Interlocutory Application (IA) No. 19 of 2025 seeking a direction to_ _**NLDC to place on record the block-wise drawl data for the period from 2018-2019 to 2023-24, as well as to provide a list of State-wise ISGS connected with both ISTS and intra-STS, along with their block-wise drawl details for the same period** . He further submitted that, according to CTUIL’s submissions, block-wise data was not available with it, and NLDC has not yet responded to the issuance of data. He also stated that, in compliance with the directions of the Commission vide RoP dated 19.2.2025, CTUIL, through an affidavit dated 24.4.2025, furnished the quantum of the LTA/MTOA only with respect to_ _**regional entity generating stations connected with both ISTS and intra-State transmission systems** . Learned counsel urged the Commission to dispose of the IA No. 19 of 2025 based on the documents available on the record._ _3. After the hearing, the Commission reserved the order on the IA No. 19 of 2025_ .” 7. We have considered the submissions of the Petitioner, Respondent and perused the facts available on record. 8. The Petitioner in the instant IA No. 19/2025 has reiterated its submission made under the main Petition and prayed that the Commission directs NLDC to furnish (i) the block-wise drawal details of the applicant using an inter-State transmission system and Intra-STS from ISGS for the period from 2018-2019 to 2023-2024, and (ii) list of State-wise ISGS, which are connected with both ISTS and Intra-STS along with their block wise drawal details for the period from 2018-2019 to 2023-2024. 9. We have considered the submissions of the Petitioner. Under this Order, only the prayers made in the IA have been discussed. 17. We have also perused the Commission`s Order dated 18.01.2024 in Petition No. 224/MP/2022 on a similar matter, wherein the Petitioner, PCKL, had prayed to exclude the quantum of share of the Petitioner in UPCL drawn through the State Transmission Network from the total LTA considered for computation of ISTS charges and losses as per the provisions of the 2020 Sharing Regulations and Detailed Procedure for the period starting from 1.11.2020. The relevant extract of the Order dated18.1.2024 is as below: 20. Considering the above discussion and the prayers made under the main Petitions vis-à-vis the prayers made under the instant IA, no relevance of the actual drawal from ISGS connected to both ISTS and intra-STS is established for the instant matter. Therefore, we do not find any merit or relevance in providing the actual drawal data of the Petitioner from 21. Further, the Petitioner at prayer (b) has prayed to provide the list of the State-wise ISGS which are connected to both ISTS and Intra-STS along with their block-wise drawal details for the period from 2018-2019 to 2023-2024. Since the Petitioner has not established the requirement or any relevance of such drawal data of the other State in its prayers made under the main Petition, we do not find any relevance in providing such drawal data of the other State. Accordingly, the prayer (b) made under the instant IA is rejected. 22. IA.No.19/2025 in Petition No.319/MP/2022 is disposed of in terms of the above.
